description: Published Figure 2 cost-record observations. Each record is the cheapest qualifying run among models released by that date. At most one observation per release date per benchmark/threshold. No points extrapolated or synthesized from annual decline rates.
date_semantics: Release date assigned by source; retrospective evaluation and price data, not an archived contemporaneous provider tariff series.
cost_semantics: USD per benchmark question, with truncated-token-budget method described in report; not USD per token. Source may include rented-hardware estimates for open models without hosted APIs.
threshold_semantics: Chance-adjusted accuracy; source rescales random-guessing floor to 0. GPQA is four-choice:25% adjusted corresponds43.75% raw,75% adjusted corresponds81.25% raw.
limitations: Includes open and closed models, model changes, software and hardware changes. Does not isolate same-hardware improvements.
The market frontier assumes switching to cheapest qualifying model, not the typical provider price.
Some dates and model labels are as published, e.g. Gemini2.5Pro(Jun2025) label occurs atMarch25 andJune5 releases. Retain source rows rather than silently correcting.
Connecting records with step lines represents the retrospective frontier among observed releases. Do not extrapolate after last record or interpret as all-market coverage.
